title: HLSE Audit Verdict
description: JSON output of `hlse_core --json audit` — comprehensive OS hardening assessment with CVSS-aligned findings.

hlse_version.description: HLSE engine version that produced this verdict.

hardening_index.description: Hardening score: 0–49 weak, 50–69 fair, 70–89 good, 90+ hardened.

hardening_band.description: Qualitative hardening level. 'partial' whenever checks_skipped > 0: the index is 100 - score and a check that could not read its evidence contributes 0, so the reassuring band word is withheld.

checks_run.description: Number of hardening checks that ran and read their evidence.

checks_skipped.description: Number of hardening checks that could not run because their evidence could not be read. Checks that could not run emit an AUDIT_INFO finding naming the unreadable path; they never emit AUDIT_PASS.

crit_count.description: Number of CRITICAL (severity 5) findings — actively exploitable.

severity.description: 0=PASS 1=INFO 2=LOW 3=MED 4=HIGH 5=CRITICAL (actively exploitable). Do not confuse with the top-level `severity` field (0-4 SAFE..ISOLATE action band) — this is a distinct 0-5 per-finding scale.
